title: General Manager -HR ( Manufacturing Company)
description:
We are seeking an experienced General Manager – HR \& Administration to lead our human resources and administrative functions. The ideal candidate will have extensive expertise in end\-to\-end HR and administrative operations within the manufacturing industry. This role requires a strategic leader who can manage organizational growth, ensure compliance, develop talent, and drive operational excellence across the organization.
 



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 Human Resources \& Talent Management:
 



 Develop and implement comprehensive HR strategies aligned with organizational objectives
 



 Oversee recruitment, selection, and onboarding processes for all levels of personnel
 



 Manage performance management systems, employee development, and succession planning
 



 Ensure competitive compensation and benefits structures
 



 Foster organizational culture and employee engagement programs
 



**Compliance \& Administration:** 




 Ensure full compliance with labor laws, regulations, and statutory requirements
 



 Manage payroll, leave management, and employee benefits administration
 



 Maintain employee records, documentation, and HR information systems
 



 Handle grievance redressal and employee relations matters
 



**Operations \& Strategic Planning:** 




 Manage overall HR and administrative budgets and resources
 



 Lead administrative operations including facilities, procurement, and vendor management
 



 Implement HR systems, policies, and procedures for organizational efficiency
 



 Collaborate with departmental heads to address HR and operational needs
 



  





**Educational Qualification:** 




 Master of Social Work (MSW), Master of Business Administration (MBA), or related Master's degree
 



  





**EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS** 




 Minimum 20 years of overall experience in Human Resources and Administration
 



 Minimum 2\+ years of experience in a General Manager or similar senior leadership role
 



 Proven experience of end\-to\-end HR and Administrative operations in the manufacturing industry
 



 Exposure to diverse manufacturing sectors including Apparel, Textile, Retail, or related industries

title: Assistant Manager - Learning & Development
description:
**Assistant Manager \- Learning \& Development** 




**Location:** 
 Sarovar Portico, Sriperumbudur (Pre\-Opening)
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 As an Assistant Manager \- Learning \& Development, you will play a key role in shaping the service culture, building operational excellence, and ensuring all team members are fully equipped for launch. This position offers the rare opportunity to help create a brand\-new hotel culture from the ground up.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Assist in designing and implementing the full pre\-opening training calendar for all departments.
* Coordinate onboarding and orientation sessions aligned with Sarovar Group’s brand values.
* Collaborate with HODs to identify specific training needs and facilitate skills development workshops.
* Monitor and evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, feedback, and performance tracking.
* Support implementation of Learning \& Development tools and track compliance with statutory requirements.
* Help create a culture of continuous learning, empowerment, and guest\-centric service.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Human Resources, or related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in hotel training or operations, preferably with prior pre\-opening exposure.
* Strong understanding of SOP creation, departmental training matrices, and brand standard modules.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills.
* A Proactive professional with high energy, creativity, and a strong commitment to team success.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job Description** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Recruitment \& Manpower Planning** 



* Strong knowledge on recruitment, must have good English fluent knowledge.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, employee referrals, consultants, and other recruitment channels.
* Coordinate with manpower consultants and recruitment agencies when required.
* Plan manpower requirements based on production, quality, R\&D, sales, warehouse, and support functions.
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment from sourcing to onboarding.
* Coordinate interviews and selection with department heads.
* Ensure timely joining and effective employee induction.



**2\. Employee Relations** 



* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, absenteeism, and workplace issues.
* Conduct employee engagement initiatives and address employee concerns.
* Support management in resolving workplace conflicts.








**3\. Payroll \& Attendance** 



* Manage monthly attendance, leave, overtime, and payroll inputs for contractors
* Coordinate with accounts/payroll teams for accurate and timely salary processing.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
* Monitor attendance, absenteeism, and manpower costs.



**4\. Statutory Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Bonus, Gratuity, Minimum Wages, Factory\-related requirements, and other applicable compliances with finance team
* Maintain statutory registers, records, notices, and documentation.
* Coordinate labour inspections, audits, and statutory submissions where required.
* Factory/establishment licence and renewal coordination.
* Contractor and contract labour documentation.
* Maintaining statutory registers and records.
* Supporting labour inspections and statutory audits.
* Monitoring compliance\-related notices and submissions.



**5\. Performance Management** 



* Develop and implement performance appraisal processes.
* Coordinate goal setting, performance reviews, and employee development plans.
* Support managers in performance\-related discussions and corrective actions.
* Track employee performance and HR metrics.



**6\. Training \& Development** 



* Identify training needs across production, quality, R\&D, warehouse, sales, and support teams.
* Prepare annual training calendars with the help of quality team
* Coordinate technical, behavioral, safety, GMP, hygiene, and compliance\-related training.
* Maintain training records and evaluate training effectiveness.



**7\. HR Policies \& Processes** 



* Develop, implement, and periodically update HR policies and SOPs.
* Establish effective systems for recruitment, onboarding, confirmation, promotion, transfer, leave, attendance, and separation.
* Ensure consistent implementation of HR policies across departments.



**Admin Activities** 



* Managing office and factory administrative operations.
* Housekeeping, security, canteen, transport, and facility management.
* Monitoring office/factory infrastructure and maintenance requirements.
* Managing stationery, uniforms, ID cards, and other employee requirements.
* Vendor coordination and administration\-related purchase activities.
* Managing company vehicles and transportation arrangements.
* Monitoring security and visitor management.
* Maintaining administrative records, agreements, licenses, and AMC documents.
* Coordinating meetings, events, employee functions, and official programs.
* Supporting safety, emergency preparedness, and workplace discipline.
* Managing employee accommodation, if provided by the company.
* Handling courier, postal, travel, and other general administrative requirements.



  





**Requirements** 




**Preferred Skills** 



* Manufacturing/plant HR experience.
* Recruitment and workforce planning.
* Labour\-law and statutory compliance.
* Payroll and attendance management.
* Employee relations and grievance handling.
* Training and development.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to work with employees at all organizational levels.

title: Human Resource Recruitment
description:
HR RECRUITER – SUPERMARKET CHAIN
   

  

 Location: Kanchipuram
   

 Industry: Retail / Supermarket
   

  

 1\. Handle end\-to\-end recruitment for all supermarket stores and support functions.
   

  

 2\. Understand store\-wise manpower requirements and maintain an updated vacancy tracker.
   

  

 3\. Source candidates through Naukri, job portals, social media, WhatsApp groups, referrals and local networks.
   

  

 4\. Conduct telephonic screening and shortlist candidates based on role requirements.
   

  

 5\. Coordinate interviews with Store Managers and Department Heads and ensure timely feedback.
   

  

 6\. Manage salary discussion, offer release, candidate follow\-up and joining closure.
   

  

 7\. Build and maintain a strong candidate database and ready\-to\-join talent pool for recurring retail positions.
   

  

 8\. Conduct walk\-in interviews and local recruitment drives whenever required.
   

  

 9\. Maintain daily recruitment MIS covering sourcing, screening, interviews, selection, offers and joining status.
   

  

 10\. Achieve defined recruitment targets and TAT, while continuously improving candidate quality and joining conversion.
   

  

 Preferred: 3\-5 years of recruitment experience, preferably in Retail / Supermarket / FMCG / Blue\-Collar hiring. Good Tamil communication and strong follow\-up skills are essential.

title: HR EXECUTIVE
description:
HR Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

* Recruitment \& Hiring: Prepare job descriptions, post vacancies, screen candidates, coordinate interviews, issue offer letters, and support workforce planning.
* Onboarding \& Offboarding: Conduct employee orientation, collect documentation, coordinate joining formalities, manage exit procedures, and conduct exit interviews.
* Employee Records: Maintain employee files, attendance, leave records, contracts, personal information, and HR databases/HRIS.
* Payroll \& Benefits Support: Coordinate attendance and salary inputs, deductions, bonuses, insurance, retirement benefits, and other employee benefits.
* Performance Management: Coordinate performance reviews, help establish goals/KPIs, maintain appraisal records, and support performance\-improvement processes.
* Training \& Development: Identify training needs, organize learning programs, track employee development, and support career\-development initiatives.
* Employee Relations: Address employee concerns and grievances, help resolve workplace conflicts, support disciplinary procedures, and promote a positive work environment.
* Policies \& Compliance: Develop and communicate HR policies and help ensure compliance with employment laws, workplace regulations, health and safety requirements, and company procedures.
* Engagement \& Culture: Organize employee\-engagement activities, gather feedback, conduct surveys, and support organizational culture and employee retention.
* HR Reporting: Prepare reports on headcount, turnover, absenteeism, recruitment, performance, and other HR metrics.
* Management Support: Advise managers on employee matters, staffing requirements, organizational changes, promotions, compensation, and workforce planning.

title: Senior Associate - Resource Management
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Senior Associate, Resource Management supports staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, workforce analytics, and resource optimization activities for the India Tax practice. This role works closely with the Manager, Talent Optimization and Tax leadership to facilitate effective resource deployment, monitor capacity and utilization, support staffing decisions, and maintain accurate workforce data.
   

  

 The Senior Associate serves as a key contributor to workforce planning efforts by providing reporting, analysis, and operational support to help ensure resources are aligned with business demands while supporting employee development, engagement objectives, and operational excellence across U.S. and India teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Scheduling \& Staffing Support**
* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.
* Assist with processing staffing requests and ensuring schedules remain accurate, current, and aligned with business needs.
* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.
* Assist with work transitions, reassignments, and workload balancing activities as directed.
* Maintain accurate staffing information in scheduling tools, trackers, reports, and workforce planning systems.


**Capacity, Utilization \& Workforce Analytics**
* Prepare and analyze capacity, utilization, staffing, and availability reports for leadership review.
* Track employee availability, chargeable hour projections, and scheduled commitments to support workforce visibility.
* Monitor schedule changes and ensure updates are reflected in timely reporting systems.
* Identify trends in staffing, utilization, and resource availability and communicate insights to support decision\-making.
* Support data validation efforts to improve reporting accuracy, workforce visibility, and data integrity.
* Assist in workforce planning activities by monitoring forecasted workload, resource demand, and skill requirements.
* Provide scheduling, utilization, and capacity\-related information as requested by management.


**Coordination \& Stakeholder Communication**
* Serve as a resource for routine scheduling inquiries from team members, managers, and engagement teams.
* Coordinate with U.S. and India Tax teams to gather staffing information, scheduling updates, and resource needs.
* Build effective working relationships with U.S. and India leadership teams to support resource deployment decisions.
* Facilitate communication regarding staffing conflicts, priorities, workload balancing, and schedule changes.
* Escalate staffing concerns, scheduling issues, or capacity risks to the Manager, Talent Optimization when appropriate.


**Process \& Administrative Support**
* Follow established scheduling procedures, guidelines, and best practices.
* Assist with maintaining scheduling documentation, process materials, and training resources.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance scheduling efficiency, reporting quality, and data accuracy.
* Participate in team meetings, scheduling calls, capacity review exercises, and workforce planning discussions.
* Assist with onboarding and training activities related to scheduling tools, reporting processes, and resource management procedures.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, or related fields.
* 2\-4 years of experience in resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, professional services operations, project coordination, or related discipline.
* Experience in a CPA firm, tax practice, public accounting, or professional services environment preferred.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills, including pivot tables, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Experience with resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, ERP, or reporting platforms; Microsoft Dynamics or similar systems preferred.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, critical thinking, and follow\-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and shift business needs in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, summarize findings, and support practical solutions.


**Core Competencies**
 Resource Coordination
   

  

 Relationship Management
   

  

 Schedule Management
   

  

 Problem Solving
   

  

 Capacity Planning \& Tracking
   

  

 Business Acumen
   

  

 Workforce Analytics
   

  

 Time Management
   

  

 Operational Support
   

  

 Attention to Detail
   

  

 Data Accuracy \& Reporting
   

  

 Adaptability
   

  

**Success Measures**
* Accuracy and integrity of staffing, scheduling, and workforce planning data.
* Timely and effective processing of staffing requests and schedule updates.
* Quality, reliability, and usefulness of capacity, utilization, and availability reporting.
* Proactive identification and communication of capacity constraints, staffing risks, and workload imbalances.
* Responsiveness to scheduling inquiries and ability to support timely decision\-making.
* Effective support of workload balancing, resource deployment, and staffing processes across U.S. and India teams.
* Positive stakeholder feedback from leadership, managers, and engagement teams.
* Contribution to improved scheduling efficiency, utilization of visibility, and resource management processes.
